'''Murk''' was a dim [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]] located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]]. It was invisible to unaided observation from all of the [[Sector/Legends|subsector's]] inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Murk was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by an [[Atmosphere/Legends|airless]] [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] of the [[Murk (planetoid)|same name]].

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established the [[Sanctuary Pipeline/Legends|Sanctuary Pipeline]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], Murk and its [[Murk system/Legends|star system]] became the penultimate stop on the route before it terminated at the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. A [[cargo-transfer station]] was established on the planetoid, where, in the light of the [[Color/Legends|red]] dwarf, Imperial crews unloaded shipments arriving via the Sanctuary Pipeline for further [[Transport/Legends|transportation]] to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==Description==
Murk was a [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]]&ndash;type [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="Endor" /> located within the [[Murk system/Legends|Murk system]]. It lay within the [[Outer Moddell systems]] area of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsector]],<ref name="EAOC Murk" /> one of the [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] making up the [[Inner Zuma Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]].<ref name="EAOC Murk" />

Murk was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by several [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoids]], the innermost of which, an [[Atmosphere/Legends|airless]], [[Temperature/Legends|frigid]], barren rock, was also named [[Murk (planetoid)|Murk]]. The latter took ninety-eight local [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to complete an orbit around its sun. When viewed from the planetoid, Murk's light was dim maroon in [[Color/Legends|color]] and was not brighter than a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of an average [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In fact, Murk was so dim that it was invisible to naked-[[Eye/Legends|eye]] observers on all of the inhabited planets of the Moddell subsector.<ref name="Endor" />

==History==
[[File:Murk-TEAmap.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Murk became notable among red dwarf stars due to its strategic location on the Sanctuary Pipeline.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] began the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. To allow for expeditious&mdash;and secret&mdash;[[Transport/Legends|transportation]] of necessary materials and components to Endor, the Empire [[S-thread booster/Legends|artificially]] extended a [[Silvestri Trace|hyperlane]], subsequently known as the [[Sanctuary Pipeline/Legends|Sanctuary Pipeline]], directly to Endor,<ref name="Endor" /> with the Murk [[Star system/Legends|system]] becoming a penultimate stop on the new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]].<ref name="TEA" /> As a result, the system's star emerged from the obscurity characteristic to most red dwarfs<ref name="Endor" /> and became relatively notable.<ref name="TEA" />

To add another layer of secrecy to the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] project, an Imperial [[cargo-transfer station]] was established on the planetoid Murk. In the dim light of the planetoid's sun, Imperial crews of the station unloaded cargoes of raw materials and components from deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Freighter/Legends|haulers]] and [[superfreighter]]s traveling along the Sanctuary Pipeline for further transportation to the Endor system. Following the Imperial defeat by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Endor" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Sanctuary Pipeline became largely [[Navigator/Legends|unnavigable]], and the Murk transfer station was abandoned.<ref name="Endor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star Murk was first mentioned in the article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]," which was authored by [[Craig Robert Carey]], [[Daniel Wallace]], and [[Jason Fry]], and was published in [[Star Wars Gamer 9|''Star Wars Gamer'' 9]]<ref name="Endor" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', illustrated by [[Chris Trevas]], provided the first visual depiction of the red dwarf and placed it in grid square H-16.<ref name="TEA" />
